retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast silhouette of a performer against a massive, bokeh-lit crowd with aggressive, perspective-shifted typography.
excludeWhen: soft or pastel color palettes are required
intimate small-club settings are the goal
clear facial features of the subject are necessary

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition featuring a male silhouette in profile holding a microphone, set against a deep teal background filled with thousands of small, bright white light points representing a distant crowd. The foreground is dominated by large, three-dimensional sans-serif text that follows a dynamic upward diagonal perspective.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette vs. bright lens flare highlights
Teal-toned background vs. warm yellow and cool blue typography
Diagonal text orientation vs. vertical subject posture
Dense bokeh texture vs. clean graphic text blocks
coreInvariants: High-contrast backlighting creating a rim-light effect on the silhouette
Perspective-distorted typography that appears to recede into the distance

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The performer is positioned on the right third of the frame, full-body silhouette from the waist up, scaled to occupy the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, light-blue perspective text in the lower-left quadrant acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright lens flare on the left, moves across the crowd lights to the silhouette, then follows the diagonal text back down to the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper-left quadrant is primarily negative space filled with bokeh light points.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and black for the background and silhouette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the lens flares and crowd bokeh.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and icy blue for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black silhouette and the white light sources; medium saturation in the teal tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic weight variation with color contrast (Yellow vs. Blue).

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the display text.
Offers a classic, authoritative feel for the subtitle text.
Modern geometric alternative for a cleaner look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a male performer's silhouette in profile holding a microphone. The background should be a dark teal stadium at night, filled with thousands of tiny white bokeh light points. Include a bright white lens flare in the upper left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the lower half of the frame. The text should be tilted 15 degrees upward and warped with a perspective effect so the right side appears further away. Use golden yellow for the top lines and a light blue-to-white gradient for the largest bottom line.

verificationChecks: Is the subject a pure silhouette?
Does the text have a clear perspective warp?
Are the lens flares present and bright?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the teal color grade
Density of the crowd bokeh lights
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the comedian
Any specific brand logos or parental advisory stickers

mustAchieve: Consistent perspective across all text elements
avoid: Muddy colors in the teal background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the silhouette doesn't have internal detail.
Ensure the perspective of the text matches the implied floor plane.
Verify the teal color isn't shifting into green or blue-only.
Confirm the lens flare doesn't obscure the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Performer Silhouette + Stadium Bokeh + Perspective Bold Type + Teal/Gold Palette
